utterances.speaker: JUDGE VAN DEN WYNGAERT
utterances.text: Good afternoon, ladies and gentlemen. May I ask the registrar to call the case, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon Your Honours, this is the case number IT-95-12, the Prosecutor versus Ivica Rajic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE VAN DEN WYNGAERT
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Mr. Rajic, can you understand me?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I am not receiving the interpretation.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] [In English] I am not translator. [Interpretation] It's all right now.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE VAN DEN WYNGAERT
utterances.text: Can I have the appearances now. First the appearance for the Prosecution?

utterances.speaker: MR. SCOTT
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Madam President, Your Honours. My name is Kenneth Scott. I appear on behalf of the Prosecutor. I am joined today by Ms. Josee D'Aoust, and also our case manager, Skye Winner. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE VAN DEN WYNGAERT
utterances.text: Thank you very much. For the Defence, please.

utterances.speaker: MS. KOSTA
utterances.text: [Interpretation] The Chairman and President, my name is Doris Kosta, and I am Defence counsel for Ivica Rajic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE VAN DEN WYNGAERT
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Before turning to the subject matter of today's hearing, this Court has to address a preliminary question, which follows a motion that has been brought by the Defence concerning private matters relating to the situation of Mr. Rajic. Since this was a confidentially filed motion, we are now turning into private session for a little while. So may I please ask the court officer to proceed.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: We are in open session, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE VAN DEN WYNGAERT
utterances.text: Following the preliminary motion that was submitted to the Trial Chamber before starting the sentencing hearing, the Trial Chamber has decided to suspend the hearing and the hearing is now adjourned.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 3.29 p.m.
